AdvancedSettings.backend.remote.enabled: Whether to use a remote backend
AdvancedSettings.developerMode.overlay: Whether to show debug info in the overlay
AdvancedSettings.developerMode.customBackend.enabled: Whether to enable a custom backend
AdvancedSettings.developerMode.customBackend.command: Custom backend command/executable, e.g. python, sra-cli, uv, or an executable path
AdvancedSettings.developerMode.customBackend.arguments: Custom backend launch arguments, e.g. main.py, -m SRACore
AdvancedSettings.developerMode.customBackend.workingDirec: Custom backend working directory; uses the program's current directory when empty
AdvancedSettings.developerMode.saveOcrImage: Whether to save OCR screenshots for debugging

CosmicStrifeConfig.enabled: Whether to enable the Cosmic Strife task
CosmicStrifeConfig.currencyWars.mode: Currency Wars mode, 0=Standard match, 1=Overclock match, 2=opening reroll
CosmicStrifeConfig.currencyWars.pointRewards: When enabled, skip the Currency Wars task if Cosmic Strife point rewards are full
CosmicStrifeConfig.currencyWars.reroll.bossAffixes: Boss affixes for Currency Wars opening reroll
CosmicStrifeConfig.currencyWars.reroll.bossNames: Boss names for Currency Wars opening reroll
CosmicStrifeConfig.currencyWars.reroll.investEnvironments: Investment environments for Currency Wars opening reroll
CosmicStrifeConfig.currencyWars.reroll.investStrategies: Investment strategies for Currency Wars opening reroll
CosmicStrifeConfig.currencyWars.runtimes: Number of runs for Currency Wars opening reroll
CosmicStrifeConfig.currencyWars.strategy: Strategy name used in Currency Wars
CosmicStrifeConfig.currencyWars.strategyIndex: Strategy index used in Currency Wars
CosmicStrifeConfig.divergentUniverse.useTechnique: Whether to use Technique for fast Divergent Universe farming
CosmicStrifeConfig.pointRewards.enabled: Whether to enable point rewards; when enabled, skip this task once the weekly point cap is reached

DisplaySettings.backgroundImage.uri: Background image URI, either a local path or a web URL
DisplaySettings.window.remember: Whether to remember window position and size
DisplaySettings.window.position.x: X coordinate of the main window
DisplaySettings.window.position.y: Y coordinate of the main window

GeneralSettings.gamePath.index: Game path index, pointing to one URI in gamePath.uris
GeneralSettings.gamePath.uris: List of game paths, supports multiple paths for quick switching
GeneralSettings.gamePath.autoDetect: Whether to auto-detect the game path; when enabled, scans common install locations to find the game path
GeneralSettings.gameArgs.enabled: Whether to enable game launch arguments; when enabled, launches the game with the arguments below
GeneralSettings.gameArgs.fullScreenMode: Game window mode, e.g. windowed, fullscreen
GeneralSettings.gameArgs.windowSize: Game window size in widthxheight format, e.g. 1920x1080
GeneralSettings.gameArgs.popupWindow: Whether to use a borderless game window
GeneralSettings.gameArgs.useCmd: Whether to launch the game via the command line (avoids issues caused by direct launching)
GeneralSettings.gameArgs.advanced: Advanced launch arguments, passed directly to the game process and overriding other argument settings
GeneralSettings.cloudGame.browser.path: Path to the browser used for cloud gaming
GeneralSettings.cloudGame.browser.headless: Whether the cloud gaming browser runs headless
GeneralSettings.cloudGame.browser.muteAudio: Whether the cloud gaming browser is muted
GeneralSettings.keybindings.f1: Hotkey for opening the events screen
GeneralSettings.keybindings.f2: Hotkey for opening the Nameless Honor screen
GeneralSettings.keybindings.f3: Hotkey for opening the warp screen
GeneralSettings.keybindings.f4: Hotkey for opening the guide screen
GeneralSettings.ocrMatchConfidence: OCR recognition confidence, range 0-1, higher is stricter
GeneralSettings.templateMatchConfidence: Template matching confidence (recognition confidence), range 0-1, higher is stricter
GeneralSettings.isRetryOnTaskFailure: Whether to restart the game and retry after a task failure
GeneralSettings.maxRetryCount: Maximum number of retries after a task failure

MissionAccomplishedConfig.exitApp: Whether to exit the app after completing tasks
MissionAccomplishedConfig.exitGame: Whether to exit the game after completing tasks
MissionAccomplishedConfig.logoff: Whether to log off the current user after completing tasks
MissionAccomplishedConfig.logout: Whether to log out of the account after completing tasks
MissionAccomplishedConfig.shutdown: Whether to shut down the computer after completing tasks
MissionAccomplishedConfig.sleep: Whether to put the computer to sleep after completing tasks

NotificationSettings.bark.ciphertext: Ciphertext for Bark push, sent as the ciphertext parameter when set
NotificationSettings.bark.deviceKey: Bark device key, supports multiple devices separated by commas
NotificationSettings.bark.icon: URL of the Bark push icon
NotificationSettings.bark.sound: Name of the Bark push sound
NotificationSettings.dingTalk.enabled: Whether to enable DingTalk bot push
NotificationSettings.dingTalk.secret: Signing secret of the DingTalk bot (starts with SEC)
NotificationSettings.dingTalk.webhookUrl: Webhook URL of the DingTalk bot
NotificationSettings.discord.sendImage: Whether to attach screenshots to Discord push
NotificationSettings.feishu.appId: App ID of the Feishu app
NotificationSettings.feishu.appSecret: App Secret of the Feishu app
NotificationSettings.feishu.receiveIdType: Feishu receiver ID type, e.g. open_id, user_id, union_id, chat_id
NotificationSettings.feishu.webhookUrl: Webhook URL of the Feishu bot
NotificationSettings.oneBot.sendImage: Whether to attach screenshots to OneBot push
NotificationSettings.oneBot.groupId: Target group number for OneBot push
NotificationSettings.telegram.proxyEnabled: Whether to enable a proxy for Telegram push
NotificationSettings.telegram.sendImage: Whether to attach screenshots to Telegram push
NotificationSettings.weCom.sendImage: Whether to attach screenshots to WeCom push
NotificationSettings.weCom.webhookUrl: Webhook URL of the WeCom bot
NotificationSettings.webhook.enabled: Whether to enable custom Webhook push
NotificationSettings.email.smtpPort: SMTP server port, usually 465 for SSL
NotificationSettings.telegram.botToken: Bot Token of the Telegram bot
NotificationSettings.onCompleted: List of task names to send notifications when completed
NotificationSettings.onStart: List of task names to send notifications when started

ReceiveRewardsConfig.enabled: Whether to enable the claim rewards task
ReceiveRewardsConfig.rewards.dailyTraining: Whether to claim Daily Training rewards
ReceiveRewardsConfig.rewards.giftOfOdyssey: Whether to claim Gift of Odyssey rewards
ReceiveRewardsConfig.rewards.namelessHonor: Whether to claim Nameless Honor rewards
ReceiveRewardsConfig.rewards.trailblazeProfile: Whether to claim Trailblazer Profile rewards
ReceiveRewardsConfig.redeemCodes: List of redeem codes, format: code1 code2 code3; the task automatically fetches the latest codes from the official website and redeems them as well

StartGameConfig.enabled: Whether to enable the start game task
StartGameConfig.game.server: Global server, 0=Asia, 1=Europe, 2=America, 3=TW/HK/MO, only effective for Global
StartGameConfig.game.useGlobalPath: Whether to use the game path from global settings
StartGameConfig.game.launchDelay: Wait delay after launching the game (seconds)
StartGameConfig.relogin: Whether to log in again automatically after a login failure

TrailblazePowerConfig.enabled: Whether to enable the Trailblaze Power task
TrailblazePowerConfig.activity.gardenOfPlenty.level1: Target stage for Calyx (Golden) in Garden of Plenty
TrailblazePowerConfig.activity.gardenOfPlenty.level2: Target stage for Calyx (Crimson) in Garden of Plenty
TrailblazePowerConfig.useBuildTarget: Whether to enable training targets; when enabled, training targets are completed first
TrailblazePowerConfig.materialPriority: Training target material priority: skip Ornament Extraction and Cavern of Corrosion when material stages are detected, keep them otherwise
TrailblazePowerConfig.activity.enabled: Whether to enable double event detection; when enabled, Garden of Plenty/Realm of the Strange/Planar Fissure stages are prioritized
TrailblazePowerConfig.activity.realmOfTheStrange.level: Target stage for Realm of the Strange
TrailblazePowerConfig.replenish.way: Trailblaze Power replenish method, 0=Reserved Trailblaze Power, 1=Fuel, 2=Stellar Jade

TrailblazePowerTaskItem.name: Task name
TrailblazePowerTaskItem.count: Number of executions per task in manual mode
TrailblazePowerTaskItem.runtimes: Number of execution rounds in manual mode
TrailblazePowerTaskItem.autoDetect: Whether to automatically allocate execution counts based on remaining Trailblaze Power

UpdateSettings.autoUpdate: Whether to enable auto update: starts downloading immediately when an update is available
UpdateSettings.checkForUpdates: Whether to enable update checking: checks for updates at startup and notifies the user
UpdateSettings.downloadPath: Directory for saving downloaded update installers; if empty, uses the SRA folder in the system temp directory
UpdateSettings.mirrorChyanCdk: Authorization code for the Mirror Chyan download channel; sensitive information is stored encrypted
